title: Youth CLIMATE: Youth and Climate emotions, Lifestyle, Identity, Mental health, and Actions for a Thriving Environment
descriptions: The Youth CLIMATE Project (Climate emotions, Lifestyle, Identity, Mental health, and Actions for a Thriving Environment) employs a longitudinal design (cohort sequential) to assess the development of climate change-related mental health, pro-environmental behaviors, and emotions across adolescence into young adulthood.
